smoke._why: Stage 1 boot gate: clean Android + One UI + MIUI, plus the newest and the smallest iPhone.

regression._why: Stage 2 full regression. The Vivo Y21 (Helio P35 / Android 11) replaces the retired Redmi Note 9 as the slow-SoC proxy for the 2026-06-20 play-freeze class; it is a weaker proxy, because the fleet no longer offers a low-end Android 10 handset. Redmi Note 11 covers Android 11, the single largest fleet cohort (40%). iPhone 17-26 covers iOS 26, where the NativeTabs BottomAccessory mini-player and the RNS teardown crash (#160 / QARIAHV2-1G) live.

full._why: Release-candidate / quarterly sweep. Adds the Android 15-16 One UI 7 cohort (S25 Ultra, S24) implicated in the boot-hang class, the Galaxy M32 (the only non-flagship Samsung on the fleet, Android 11), and an iPad. No OnePlus below Android 13 remains available.
